Bangali Prasad vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Revenue ... on 26 September, 2025

: 
C.S.C. 
 Court No. - 2
 Hon'Ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra, J. 
Hon'Ble Brij Raj Singh, J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Standing counsel for the respondents.
2.

This writ petition has been filed with the following reliefs:-
"(i). issue a writ order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the respondents particularly to respondent no-3 to pay the 1/3 share of compensation amount of khata no. 91 khasra no. 651 measuring 5-0-4-0 bhigha situated in Village Saleh Nagar Pargana Bijnor Tahseel Sarojni Nagar District Lucknow to the petitioner along with statutory 15% interest as provided under section 34 of the land Acquisition Act 1894 from the date of possession of land till the date of actual payment."

3. At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioner states that the description of respondent no.3 is incorrect and he prays for liberty to correct the same during the course of the day.
4. Let necessary correction be incorporated during the course of the day.

5. It is the case of the petitioner that the Presiding Officer, (Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Settlement Authority), Lucknow has dismissed Reference filed under Section 13 of the Land Acquisition Act by private persons against the award of compensation to the petitioner.
Yet compensation has not been made to the petitioner.

The petitioner has already made a representation in this regard on 24.10.2024 to the Additional District Magistrate, (Land Acquisition), Nagar Mahapalika, Lucknow- respondent No.3, which representation is pending.
6.
